habits.name: Drops the right after the jab
habits.trigger: After she throws a jab at range
habits.effect: Opens the chin for a lead hook over the top. Helps the opponent.
habits.punish: A counter-puncher times the jab and lands a lead hook over it.
notes: Drops the right after she jabs. Every time.
The right hand goes walkabout on the jab.
Jab's good. Where's the right hand after it?

habits.name: Slow starter
habits.trigger: First 60 seconds of round 1
habits.effect: Gives away round 1 on the cards. Helps the opponent early.
habits.punish: A pressure fighter rushes in round 1 and banks the round.
notes: Takes a round to wake up. Can't afford that.
First minute she's still in the changing room.
Starts cold. Warm up harder.

habits.name: Digs to the body when hurt
habits.trigger: Right after she takes a clean head shot
habits.effect: Buys time and slows the opponent. Helps.
habits.punish: An opponent who knows it steps out and lands the uppercut as she dips.
notes: Hurt, goes downstairs. Smart.
When she's rocked she rips the body. Good instinct.
Takes one upstairs, gives one back to the ribs.

habits.name: Freezes on the ropes
habits.trigger: Back touches the ropes
habits.effect: Throws nothing for 2 to 3 seconds. Helps the opponent.
habits.punish: A volume puncher pins it there and empties both hands.
notes: Back on the ropes and she stops punching.
Ropes are a cage. Freezes there.
Off the ropes, or it's target practice.

habits.name: Switches stance under pressure
habits.trigger: Opponent steps in twice in a row
habits.effect: Resets the range but weakens the guard for a beat. Mixed.
habits.punish: A film-studied opponent lands the cross as she switches feet.
notes: Under pressure, flips southpaw. Messy.
Switches feet when she's pushed. Not on purpose.
The stance changes when rattled.

habits.name: Talks when ahead
habits.trigger: She has won the previous round
habits.effect: Rattles a low-temper opponent but wastes a beat. Mixed.
habits.punish: A calm opponent lands a jab while she's talking.
notes: Wins a round and starts chatting. Stop it.
She talks when she's in front. Judges hate it.
Mouth gets busy when she's ahead.

habits.name: Loads up when hurt
habits.trigger: Right after she takes a clean head shot
habits.effect: Big swing, often misses, leaves an opening. Usually helps the opponent.
habits.punish: A counter-puncher slips the wild hook and counters clean.
notes: Hurt, swings for the fences.
Gets clipped, throws a haymaker. Every time.
Stung, loses all shape.

habits.name: Covers up when hurt
habits.trigger: Right after she takes a clean head shot
habits.effect: Saves the chin but gives away the exchange. Mixed.
habits.punish: A volume puncher keeps throwing and steals the round on output.
notes: Hurt, shells up. Safe but passive.
Covers up when stung. Judges see nothing coming back.
Tight guard when hurt. Needs to punch back.

habits.name: Wide hook tell
habits.trigger: When she throws the lead hook
habits.effect: The hook is slow and seen. Helps the opponent.
habits.punish: An opponent who saw the film steps in with a straight cross first.
notes: That hook comes from the next postcode.
You can see the hook coming. Shorten it.
Wide hook. Anyone with eyes will beat it.

habits.name: Retreats in straight lines
habits.trigger: Opponent steps in
habits.effect: Ends up on the ropes fast. Helps the opponent.
habits.punish: A pressure fighter walks it straight into the corner.
notes: Backs up straight. Move off at an angle.
She retreats in a straight line to the ropes.
No angles going backwards. Learn to pivot.

habits.name: Admires the work
habits.trigger: Right after she lands a clean cross
habits.effect: Stops punching for a beat. Helps the opponent.
habits.punish: A counter-puncher fires back while she's looking.
notes: Lands a good one and stops to look at it.
Admires the shots. Keep punching.
Lands, then watches. Hands should keep going.

habits.name: Fades late
habits.trigger: Last 60 seconds of round 3 or later
habits.effect: Fewer punches late, worse defence. Helps the opponent.
habits.punish: A fit opponent saves the best work for the last minute.
notes: Gone by the last minute. Needs more roadwork.
Third round, breathing through the mouth.
Gas tank empties late. Conditioning work.

habits.name: Lunges with the jab
habits.trigger: When the opponent is just out of range
habits.effect: Reaches with the jab and loses balance. Helps the opponent.
habits.punish: An out-boxer steps back and counters as she falls in.
notes: Reaches with the jab. Step in, don't lunge.
Falls in behind the jab. Feet first.
She dives at range. Balance goes with it.

habits.name: Head down inside
habits.trigger: When the fighters are at close range
habits.effect: Hard to hit up top but blind to the uppercut. Mixed.
habits.punish: A film-studied opponent lands the uppercut inside.
notes: Head down inside. That's how uppercuts land.
Watch the eyes inside. Can't see a thing in there.
Ducks too low in close. Chin up a touch.

habits.name: Clinches when tired
habits.trigger: When conditioning drops below half in a round
habits.effect: Buys a breather but loses the exchange. Mixed.
habits.punish: An opponent who knows it works the body as she comes in to hold.
notes: Tired, grabs. The ref will warn.
Holds when she's blowing. Fair, but get fitter.
Clinches to rest. Judges notice.

habits.name: Bites on feints
habits.trigger: When the opponent feints
habits.effect: Throws the guard at nothing and opens up. Helps the opponent.
habits.punish: A boxer-puncher feints high and lands to the body.
notes: One feint and a jump. Sit still.
Bites on every feint. Smart opponents will feast.
She reacts to everything. Read before you move.

habits.name: Low lead hand
habits.trigger: When she is at range and not punching
habits.effect: Faster jab but open to the right hand. Mixed.
habits.punish: An opponent who saw the film throws the cross over the low left.
notes: Lead hand hangs low. Right hand will find it.
Carries the left too low. Gets away with it now.
Hand up. That low left will cost.

habits.name: One and done
habits.trigger: After she lands a single punch
habits.effect: Lands one clean shot then stops. Safe, but wins little.
habits.punish: A volume puncher out-throws and takes the round on output.
notes: Lands one and leaves. Throw two, throw three.
Single shots. Judges want combinations.
She never puts punches together.

habits.name: Chases the stoppage
habits.trigger: After she lands a clean blow that hurts the opponent
habits.effect: Swarms recklessly and walks onto counters. Mixed.
habits.punish: A counter-puncher waits for the rush and lands clean.
notes: Smells blood and forgets to defend.
Hurts someone and charges. Calm down.
Chases the finish. Walks onto shots doing it.

habits.name: Waits too long
habits.trigger: When the round is level and both fighters are at range
habits.effect: Throws too little and gives away close rounds. Helps the opponent.
habits.punish: A busy opponent jabs a way to the round.
notes: Waits for the perfect shot. It never comes.
Too patient. Judges score what you throw.
She's thinking when she should be punching.

heart.high: Gets hit and comes back harder. Real fighter.
heart.low: First good shot and she's looking for the exit.

temper.high: Gets hit and gets angry. Then gets sloppy.

confidence.high: Walks in like she owns the ring.
confidence.low: Doubts herself. Needs wins to believe it.

discipline.high: Does every round, every rep. Never late.
discipline.low: Skips roadwork when she thinks I'm not looking.

coachability.high: Say it once, done next round.

loyalty.high: Thinks it's a personal gym. Won't hear otherwise.
loyalty.low: Keeps asking what other gyms are like.

ring_lines.when: lead hook lands and camp focus was power
ring_lines.line: {name}'s hook keeps landing: six weeks on the pads.

ring_lines.when: jab lands 3+ times in a round and technique 70+
ring_lines.line: {name}'s jab is pure technique. The drilling shows.
{name} is still fresh. All that roadwork paid off.
{name} slips and counters, just like in sparring.

ring_lines.when: body hook lands and camp focus was body
ring_lines.line: {name} goes to the body. That's the camp plan.

ring_lines.when: takes a clean shot and chin 70+
ring_lines.line: {name} takes it well. That chin is real.

ring_lines.when: step out off the ropes and footwork 70+
ring_lines.line: {name} pivots off the ropes. The footwork drills work.

ring_lines.when: opponent habit punished and film study done
ring_lines.line: {name} saw that on the film. She was waiting.

ring_lines.when: wins round after corner call and fight_iq 70+
ring_lines.line: {name} takes the instruction and runs with it.
{name} drops the right again. The coach warned about it.
{name} freezes on the ropes, as she does in sparring.
{name} is tiring. The roadwork wasn't enough.

ring_lines.when: comes back to win a round after losing one and heart 70+
ring_lines.line: {name} digs in. That's heart, not training.
{name} swings wild after getting caught. Old habit.
{name}'s cross is too quick. Speed work on the bag.

_source: Kalli K-HABITS1 (S300), verbatim in E:/FightCamp/Game/Godot/research/K_HABITS1_KALLI.md; rulings: a habit fires at most twice a round when its trigger is true; filmed habit punished 60% of fires, 20% without film; coachability>70 removes one habit in 8 weeks of camp (discipline>70 halves it); notes show one per habit after 2 sparring sessions, all 3 after a fight. NOT tuned against playtests.
